title: surface constrained handle widget
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate a handle widget constrained to lie on a polygonal terrain surface.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkDEMReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDEMReader.html) — dem reader.
- [vtkHandleWidget](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkHandleWidget.html) — handle widget.
- [vtkImageDataGeometryFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageDataGeometryFilter.html) — converts image data to polygonal geometry.
- [vtkImageResample](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageResample.html) — image resample.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkPointHandleRepresentation3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPointHandleRepresentation3D.html) — point handle representation3d.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkPolygonalSurfacePointPlacer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolygonalSurfacePointPlacer.html) — polygonal surface point placer.
- [vtkTriangleFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTriangleFilter.html) — converts polygons into triangles.
- [vtkWarpScalar](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkWarpScalar.html) — warp scalar.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
